 Insurance: Medicare Enrollment Choices Look A Little Different This Year : 1A Medicare Open Enrollment ends Dec. 7. And this year, the choices look different.
The average person with Medicare can choose from 35 Medicare Advantage plans for 2027. That’s down from 39, according to the health policy group KFF. The yearly cap on what you can pay for covered prescriptions is going up. And a federal subsidy that helped hold down standalone drug plan premiums is going away.
It’s a lot to keep track of. How do you compare your options, and avoid the mistakes that cost money?  We put your Medicare questions to the experts.
